'''Byph''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While he could not speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], Byph understood the language while speaking [[Ithorese/Legends|Ithorese]].

==Biography==
[[File:Byph-SWE.png|thumb|left|220px|Byph with his newly constructed lightsaber]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], Byph was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Order's members were forced to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. As the war was waged around them, Byph was deemed to be one of the top members of his [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]] and suitable to travel to the sacred Jedi world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] to participate in the ancient ritual known as [[Gathering/Legends|The Gathering]]. Escorted to Ilum by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Byph and several other Initiates met with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in the [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|temple]] at the mouth of the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]].<ref name="TCW:TG" />

Entering into the caves in search of a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] for use in his personal [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Byph was forced to navigate the caves alone while the other Initiates split off into pairs. Fearing the darkness of the caves and what creatures may lurk within, Byph cowered in the dark as what appeared to be a large arachnid-like beast leered down at him in the caves. Spying his crystal locked in the pincers of the beast, Byph was forced to overcome his fears and reach inside to retrieve the crystal. Once his, the apparition vanished, revealed to be a projection of Byph's own fears and the mysterious illusions cast by the caves. Making his way back out of the caves to await the other Initiates in the Temple, Yoda commended him on overcoming his fears.<ref name="TCW:TG" />

While he and the other younglings were returning to Coruscant aboard the [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], they received instructions on lightsaber construction from [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]]. When [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang|gang]] attacked and boarded the ship he hid in the ventilation shafts with Tano, Huyang and the other younglings. Tano directed [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]] and [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]] to make their way to the cockpit, while she went to the engine control room. Tano instructed the other younglings, including Byph, to lock themselves in the hold so that they would not be sucked out into space when the ''Crucible'' broke free from the pirate ship. However, before they could reach the hold they were smoked out of the ventilation shafts and detained by the pirates. After using [[Petro/Legends|Petro's]] improperly constructed lightsaber to disable the pirates they escaped. Ignoring Tano's order to not engage the pirates, Byph helped lead the pirates into the training room where they had set a trap with the [[Marksman-H combat remote|training remotes]]. They again fled towards the hold, only to be intercepted by Ohnaka himself and more of his pirates. Unsure of how to get past the pirates, they were saved by the timely arrival of Tano, alerted to the trouble by Ganodi and Zatt. While she engaged Hondo in a duel, Byph and the other younglings sealed themselves inside the hold. Zatt activated the engines and all the pirates were sucked out of the ship. Just before the ship went into space a pirate crashed into Ahsoka, sending her into the pirate ship. Byph along with the other younglings and Huyang, was left alone on the ''Crucible''.<ref name="ATOS">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref>

Returning to the ''Crucible'', Byph constructed a blue-bladed lightsaber.<ref name="BFR">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Byph was somewhat fearful, but overcame his fears when he harvested his [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] during [[Gathering/Legends|The Gathering]].<ref name="TCW:TG" />

==Powers and abilities==
Byph was a young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] and one of the top in his class.<ref name="TCW:TG" /> He is able with [[Telekinesis/Legends|Telekinesis]] being able to make his own lightsaber.<ref name="BFR" /> He is also capable with a lightsaber being able to strike down several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="A Necessary Bond">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref>
